hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled one-sided (token-only) liquidity positions on Uniswap v4 ETH/token pools. Creators initialize a pool, seed LP at a configured price range, and later withdraw principal and accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and do not modify swap behavior.
